name: Anime Websites Helper
description: Facilitate navigation and downloading of episodes on anime websites.

command-next-resolution.description: Change the resolution for the current episode to the next resolution. The resolutions are circular, so if you are at the highest resolution, it will go back to the lowest resolution

command-switch-website.description: Switch to the other website. This is useful if the current website is not working or if you want to switch to a different website for any reason
